BIGGER.NAME: Bigger
BIGGER.DESCRIPTION: Compares two values sets 1 on the output if bigger and 0 otherwise

BIGGER_OR_EQUAL.NAME: Bigger or equal
BIGGER_OR_EQUAL.DESCRIPTION: Compares two values sets 1 on the output if bigger/equal and 0 otherwise

EQUAL.NAME: Equal
EQUAL.DESCRIPTION: Compares two values and sets 1 on the output if equal

SMALLER.NAME: Smaller
SMALLER.DESCRIPTION: Compares two values sets 1 on the output if smaler and 0 otherwise

SMALLER_OR_EQUAL.NAME: Smaller or equal
SMALLER_OR_EQUAL.DESCRIPTION: Compares two values sets 1 on the output if smaller/equal and 0 otherwise

UNEQUAL.NAME: Unequal
UNEQUAL.DESCRIPTION: Compares two values and sets 1 on the output if unequal

OUTPUT.DESCRIPTION: 1 if I1 differs from I2, otherwise 0

THRESHOLD.NAME: Threshold switch
THRESHOLD.DESCRIPTION: Switches with hysteresis between an on and an off threshold. ON above OFF: on from V >= ON (e.g. fan). ON below OFF: on from V <= ON (e.g. heating)

OUTPUT.DESCRIPTION: Switch state, unchanged between the thresholds

ON.NAME: ON threshold
ON.DESCRIPTION: The output switches on when this value is reached

OFF.NAME: OFF threshold
OFF.DESCRIPTION: The output switches off when this value is reached
1 resets the output and locks the block until Off is 0 again

VALUE_MONITOR.NAME: Analog value monitor
VALUE_MONITOR.DESCRIPTION: Reports when the value leaves the tolerance band between the lower and the upper threshold

OUTPUT.DESCRIPTION: 1 while the value is outside the tolerance band

UPPER.NAME: Upper threshold
UPPER.DESCRIPTION: Above this value the output is 1

LOWER.NAME: Lower threshold
LOWER.DESCRIPTION: Below this value the output is 1

COMPARATOR.NAME: Comparator
COMPARATOR.DESCRIPTION: Switches on when V1 - V2 rises above the on value and off when it falls below the off value

ON.NAME: On value
ON.DESCRIPTION: Difference above which the output switches on

OFF.NAME: Off value
OFF.DESCRIPTION: Difference below which the output switches off

VALUE_VALIDATOR.NAME: Value validator
VALUE_VALIDATOR.DESCRIPTION: Passes only valid values: numbers within the range that change often enough. Invalid values are dropped and set E

ENABLE.DESCRIPTION: 0 ignores the input; each 1 waits the delay once (unused = always enabled)

ERROR.DESCRIPTION: 1 while the value is invalid or did not change within the minimum change interval

CHANGE_INTERVAL.NAME: Minimum change interval [s]
CHANGE_INTERVAL.DESCRIPTION: The value must change within this time, 0 = not checked

DELAY.NAME: Delay [s]
DELAY.DESCRIPTION: Wait time after Enable = 1 before values reach the output
